material.acceptance_criteria: Every text tone class (t-*) reaches 4.5:1 against the background it sits on, and the computed ratio table is attached to the row.
material.description: widgets.js:58 defines .t-faint as var(--faint) #5f6c77 (play.html:100). Against --well #1b222a (play.html:90) the ratio is 2.98:1; against --well-dim #161c22 (play.html:92) it is 3.19:1. Tone is applied via classList t-${tone} (widgets.js:202); the 'faint' tone is set by scenarios/moba/panels.lua:367,386,406,463,732. Kalbag: HUD text must be legible for every player; WCAG 1.4.3 requires 4.5:1 for normal text. Ratios are sRGB relative-luminance values computed in a gm codemode body.
material.subject: HUD secondary text (.t-faint) fails 4.5:1 contrast: 2.98:1 on --well
material.witness: Live computed --faint #8a96a2 vs --well #1b222a 5.32:1, --well-dim #161c22 5.69:1, --well-hi #242e38 4.57:1 (WCAG relative luminance), at 1280x720 and 375x667. Fix 4fbeeebd on origin tip. CI on tip 7f68d3bcc7c7356b1291ccec7eda0b23ad2a89f2 green (ci-status 6/6 success, run 40128978828).
material.witness_plan: Recompute the contrast ratio of each t-* colour against each well and panel background from the play.html variables in a codemode body; close when all text tones report at least 4.5.
